name: WOL Forwarder
description: Wake-on-LAN (WOL) magic packets with a matching secureOn are broadcasted on your LAN.
options_description: listen_port: UDP port to send magic packets with secureOn to (usually above 50000, add-on uses host network). wol_port: broadcast destination (only when secureOn is correct). allowed_hosts: optional list of hostnames; when set, only packets from the resolved IPs are allowed.
author: erkr
